title: 1994 AMC 8 Problem 25
statement:
Find the sum of the digits in the answer to

\[\underbrace{9999\cdots99}_{94} \times \underbrace{4444\cdots44}_{94}\]

where a string of \(94\) nines is multiplied by a string of \(94\) fours.

solutions.text:
Small cases show the pattern: \(99 \times 44 = 4356\) and \(999 \times 444 = 443556.\) In general, a string of \(n\) nines times a string of \(n\) fours gives \((n-1)\) fours, then a \(3,\) then \((n-1)\) fives, then a \(6.\)

For \(n = 94,\) the product has \(93\) fours, one \(3,\) \(93\) fives, and one \(6.\) The digit sum is \(93(4) + 3\) \(+ 93(5) + 6\) \(= 93(9) + 9\) \(= 94(9)\) \(= 846.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: The product is a block of \(4\)s, then a \(3,\) then a block of \(5\)s, then a \(6\); count how many of each
